title: Tallest buildings
measure: Height in metres to the building's architectural top, including spires but not antennas, for completed buildings only. This is the standard set by the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat, which keeps the official rankings.

entries.name: Burj Khalifa
entries.note: The tallest building since 2010, and 149 m taller than the next one.
entries.source: Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH), via Britannica and Wikipedia

entries.name: Merdeka 118
